consensus_summary: Consensus primary meaning: tartaroō denotes God casting sinning/fallen angels into temporary confinement (place or condition) of gloomy darkness/chains held until judgment; distinct from Hades/Sheol and Gehenna; drawn from 2 Pet 2:4 + Jude 6 (with Enochic/Gen 6 background often noted).
book_summary: To cast sinning angels into Tartarus: confinement in chains of darkness while they await judgment; does not name the grave of the human dead or Gehenna’s destructive verdict.
consensus_core_identification: casting/confining sinning angels in dark restraint pending judgment (distinct from human dead-realm and final hell)
book_core_identification: casting sinning angels into Tartarus for confinement in chains of darkness awaiting judgment (not human grave or Gehenna)
rationale: Minimum cores are identical in referent (sinning angels), action (cast/confine), condition (chains/darkness), purpose (await judgment), and explicit exclusions (not human grave/Hades; not Gehenna). Book wording is simply more compact; no change of category, boundary, or cases.
strongest_objection: Book omits common secondary background (1 Enoch/Gen 6 Watchers vs primeval fall) that consensus notes but does not treat as altering the core identification.
